Name: Super Sleeper
Author: spoocky123
Description:
Single-Player mod that allows you to instantly regen Stamina and Health when going into bed.
Both are optional and can be changed with the help of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] or by editing the config.json file in the mod folder.
By default Stamina regen is on and ﻿Health regen is off.

Manifest.Name: SuperSleeper
Manifest.Description: Instantly replenishes stamina and health when in bed.
Manifest.Author: spoocky123
